The Deep

The Deep

A dive game under the bay: swim or pilot an ROV over a large seabed, from the pier pilings out to the seamount. A buddy on a line, an ascent line to the surface at every site, daylight that falls away as you go down, and a reserve you watch rather than count. Every job board is a real dive or restoration station; finish one and the career ledger fills.

Controls — Keyboard: WASD or the arrows to fin, Space to rise, C to sink, Shift to fin hard, E to open a job board or look at a lantern, R to launch or recover the ROV at a site, U to take the nearest ascent line, V for the camera, M for the map. Touch: the on-screen stick and buttons. Gamepad: the left stick fins.

Depth, gas, decompression and current limits are never stated here: they are per the dive plan and the tables the supervisor holds. Every zone, landmark and site is original to this platform, and no species, owner or organisation is named.
